title: MPSC recruitment row: MSU president's hunger strike enters third day

ai.summary: Mizo Students' Union president Laldinsanga's hunger strike demanding Mizoram Public Service Commission chairman R Lalramnghaka's resignation entered its third day, citing over 20 recruitment errors since the chairman took office in May 2024.

facts.quote: Aizawl, Mizo Students' Union president Laldinsanga's hunger strike demanding the resignation of Mizoram Public Service Commission chairman R Lalramnghaka entered its third day on Wednesday
demanding that Lalramnghaka take "moral responsibility" for what he described as repeated errors and lapses in the commission's recruitment process
The MPSC has committed more than 20 errors since the chairman assumed office

facts.claim: since chairman took office in May 2024
facts.quote: the commission's functioning since Lalramnghaka assumed office on May 20, 2024

ai.background_note: Mizo Students' Union president Laldinsanga has been fasting outside the MPSC office since Monday, demanding the resignation of Mizoram Public Service Commission chairman R Lalramnghaka over alleged recruitment errors and administrative lapses.
